name: Cross-species scRNA-seq integration benchmark
description: Benchmarks methods for integrating single-cell RNA-seq across species to evaluate their ability to align homologous cell types, preserve biology, and support a cross-species cell type tree.
reputation: Recognized in the single-cell computational biology community as a useful benchmark for cross-species integration methods, cited in method-comparison studies though not universally adopted.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark. Performance depends on orthology mapping, reference quality, and species-specific expression patterns; potential variability due to experimental batch effects and dataset size differences.
